titel: I'm Not Going To Die Like This: Chris Cander

einzeiler: Author Chris Cander shares her harrowing story of surviving a kidnapping in Madrid.
kurzfassung: Author Chris Cander recounts being kidnapped and attacked by a stranger while studying abroad in Madrid in 1989. For decades, she kept the assault a secret, carrying misplaced guilt while building a life focused on physical and mental strength. Eventually, writing a novel about the experience helped her realize the attack was not her fault.
stichpunkte: In 1989, 19-year-old Chris Cander was studying abroad in Madrid when a stranger lured her away under the false pretense of making a phone call.
The man drove her to an abandoned industrial area, pulled a switchblade, and threatened to kill her.
Chris fought back fiercely, kicked open the car door, and escaped, flagging down an elderly couple who drove her back to safety.
She kept the assault secret for decades from her family, friends, and authorities, feeling a misplaced sense of responsibility.
Over the next thirty years, she channeled her desire for control into competitive bodybuilding, martial arts, and other demanding pursuits.
Writing a fictionalized novel about the trauma finally allowed her to process the event and recognize that she was not to blame.
She eventually reconnected with her college friend Kelly, whose memories of that night confirmed Chris's own recollection of the attack.

clips.hook: A terrifying night in Madrid erased a student's daily memories.
clips.text: The guest explains that she cannot recall her day-to-day experiences during her time abroad because the traumatic event at the end of the trip completely blocked them out.

clips.hook: The horrifying realization after getting into a stranger's car.
clips.text: The moment the doors locked automatically and the driver sped away made the victim instantly realize she had made a grave mistake.

clips.hook: Collapsing into the arms of a friend after escaping death.
clips.text: After being driven back to the restaurant, the survivor tumbled out of the car and fell into her friend's arms in a wave of sheer relief.

clips.hook: Finally forgiving herself decades after the attack.
clips.text: Writing about the assault gave the author the necessary perspective to stop blaming herself and finally recognize her status as a survivor.

clips.hook: Surviving a kidnapping puts daily fitness prep into perspective.
clips.text: Strict diet and training regimes feel much easier to manage when someone has already lived through a kidnapping.

beschreibung:
Nineteen-year-old Chris Cander is studying abroad in Madrid when a stranger locks her inside his car and drives her far outside the city. Alone in an abandoned industrial area with a knife pressed to her neck, Chris realizes the man intends to kill her, and decides "I'm not going to die like this." In this remarkable story of survival, Chris reveals how one terrifying night has quietly shaped the strong, fearless life she built afterward.
